triggers.name: csv_file_batch
triggers.title: New CSV file in folder
triggers.description: New CSV file in on-prem folder
triggers.help: Triggers when a new CSV file is added in the selected on-premise folder. When recipe is first started, trigger will pick up lines in all CSV files in the folder. Lines will be processed in batchs in each job. Subsequently, lines in each new CSV file added in the selected folder will be processed as …

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

triggers.name: new_csv_file_batch
triggers.title: New lines in CSV file
triggers.description: New batch of lines in on-prem CSV file
triggers.help: On recipe start, trigger will pick up all existing lines in batches. Each batch is processed as individual jobs. Maximum batch size is 2000. Subsequently, new lines added to the end of the file will be processed as new job(s).

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: file
input.label: CSV file
input.hint: The first line of this file will be used as column headers in the output of this trigger.

input.name: column_separator
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: The delimiter character that separates each column in the CSV file. CSV files typically use comma .

input.name: quote_char
input.label: Quote character
input.hint: Character used to quote the CSV cell values. Select None if no quote character is used. Default value is Double quote .

input.name: encoding
input.label: File encoding
input.hint: Set the File encoding of the source CSV file. Use 'Auto-Detect' to attempt to auto-recognize the encoding based on characters in the file.

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Number of CSV lines in a batch. Maximum batch size is 2000

actions.name: upload_file
actions.title: Upload file (Legacy)
actions.description: Upload a new file to an on-prem folder
actions.help: This action has been marked as legacy and should be swapped out for our new Upload file action. Our new action enables large file sizes for transfer. Upload a new file to an on-prem folder. If a file with the same name already exists in the folder, you can choose to overwrite that file or upload a d…

input.name: folder_path
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Upload the file to this folder.

input.name: filename
input.label: File name
input.hint: File name, including extension. Do not include full path.

input.name: content
input.label: File contents
input.hint: Use File contents datapill from another action/trigger or provide text directly. Leave it blank to create an empty file at the target location.

input.name: overwrite
input.label: Overwrite existing file?
input.hint: If Yes , overwrite content of existing file with the same name. If No , create a new file and append an incremental number at the end, e.g. report_1.csv , report_2.csv .

output.hint: The last time the file was modified

output.name: existed
output.label: File existed before upload?
output.hint: True if a file with the same name already existed in the folder
